mapper.insert: insert into post_comment(post_id, user_id, content) values(#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content})
insert into post_comment_reply(comment_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, parent_reply_id, content) values(#{commentId}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{parentReplyId}, #{content})
mapper.update:
update post_comment
content = #{content},
status = #{status},
where comment_id = #{commentId}

update post_comment_reply
content = #{content},
status = #{status},
where reply_id = #{replyId}
mapper.delete: delete from comment_like where comment_id = #{commentId} and user_id = #{userId}
delete from reply_like where reply_id = #{replyId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select * from post_comment where post_id = #{postId} and status = 0 order by create_time desc

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment WHERE post_id = #{postId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment_reply r INNER JOIN post_comment c ON r.comment_id = c.comment_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId}) AS total_count
select exists(select * from comment_like where comment_id = #{commentId} and user_id = #{userId})
select exists(select * from reply_like where reply_id = #{replyId} and user_id = #{userId})

select comment_id from comment_like where user_id = #{userId} and comment_id in
#{commentId}

select reply_id from reply_like where user_id = #{userId} and reply_id in
#{replyId}
SELECT * FROM post_comment_reply WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

select pc.user_id as userId, pc.comment_id as commentId, pc.post_id as postId, pc.content as content, pc.status as status, pc.create_time as createTime, COALESCE(like_count.get_like_count, 0) as likeCount, COALESCE(reply_count.get_reply_count, 0) as replyCount from post_comment pc left join ( select comment_id, count(*) as get_like_count from comment_like group by comment_id ) like_count on pc.comment_id = like_count.comment_id left join ( select comment_id, count(*) as get_reply_count from post_comment_reply where status = 0 group by comment_id ) reply_count on pc.comment_id = reply_count.comment_id
pc.user_id = #{userId}
AND pc.status = #{status}
ORDER BY pc.create_time
ORDER BY replyCount
ORDER BY likeCount
ORDER BY pc.create_time
ASC
DESC

select r.from_user_id as userId, r.reply_id as replyId, r.comment_id as commentId, c.post_id as postId, r.status as status, r.content as content, r.create_time as createTime, COALESCE(like_count.like_count, 0) as likeCount, COALESCE(reply_count.reply_count, 0) as replyCount from post_comment_reply r inner join post_comment c on r.comment_id = c.comment_id left join ( select reply_id, count(*) as like_count from reply_like group by reply_id ) like_count on r.reply_id = like_count.reply_id left join ( select r2.parent_reply_id, count(*) as reply_count from post_comment_reply r2 where r2.status = 0 and r2.parent_reply_id is not null group by r2.parent_reply_id ) reply_count on r.reply_id = reply_count.parent_reply_id
r.from_user_id = #{userId}
AND r.status = #{status}
ORDER BY r.create_time
ORDER BY replyCount
ORDER BY likeCount
ORDER BY r.create_time
ASC
DESC
